references.text: A curse on those who do not come to help in battle, just as Meroz was cursed for not helping the Lord.
Jabez in Gilead was punished because they did not come to help in the battle, a theme similar to the curse on those who do not aid the Lord's cause.
God's promise to curse those who curse His people, a fundamental principle that also applies to those who fail to come to their aid.
A song of cursing showing God's judgment over enemies and those who oppose His will.
Joshua's curse on Jericho illustrates how curses were pronounced over those who acted against the Lord's will.
The prophet Jeremiah conveys God's judgment over Babylon, using similar language about curses and punishment.
Jesus warns against indifference and lukewarmness in supporting the Lord's cause, which can lead to rejection.
